name: Rumour facts
notes: mw-e22.11: what the player has heard and what came of it (src/game/rumours/rumours.ts). Keyed entity:rumours/<rumour id>.<state>. Written only when the player hears a rumour (a new game holds none), so a save keeps the whole journal state in facts.

facts.description: The player has heard this rumour (a `rumor.told` emit from a teller, or a `revealRumor` effect). Its target is now a lead. Never reset.
A heard rumour's target has been visited (arrival volume entered, NPC spoken to, quest started). Written with the logic event rumor.resolved. Dot's follow-up line is offered once this is set.

The player learned a false or half-true rumour is wrong: they saw for themselves (a debunk `dive` place visited) or were told by the debunker (the `rumor.corrected` emit). Written with the logic event rumor.debunked.
Dot has traded back the follow-up line for this rumour (once only, her dialogue sets it).
